behavior: Recognized skills inherit REQUIRED in explicit Required, Minimum, or Basic Qualifications sections and PREFERRED in explicit Preferred or Desired Qualifications sections.

Inline recognized qualification headings classify following skills, and conflicting inline cues remain UNKNOWN.
Conflicting local cues remain UNKNOWN, and a prose reference to a heading label is not interpreted as a section heading or strength cue.
Manual capture stores the resulting required/preferred skill lists; after SQLite close/reopen, explainable match details retain the strength and profile evidence explanation.
Connected Jobs detail renders REQUIRED and PREFERRED strengths after capture and match refresh.
